_comment: #728: source definition of pdhc_vitals.v1 for scripts/build_opt.py. pdhc_vitals.v1.opt itself was exported from Archetype Designer (2026-05-24) and is sandbox-accepted; this file exists so the generator can REGENERATE it as the control that the generator is right (app/tests/test_build_opt.py). Vitals inlines its four archetypes whole: no keep/constrain.

content._term_overrides: Template-level text override carried by the accepted OPT (inherited from vital_signs_poc): CKM has said 'SpO₂' (subscript two) in every revision since 1.1.3 (2020); the OPT spells 'SpO2'. Web-template id is 'spo2' either way.

at0006.comment: SpO2 is defined as the percentage of oxyhaemoglobin (HbO₂) to the total concentration of haemoglobin (HbO₂ + deoxyhaemoglobin) in peripheral blood.
